meta.flows_name: The Bank of Korea flow of funds
rules: Flows are drawn only where a source measures them (BoK flow of funds, KRX investor net buying).
Pool sizes are official levels; weeks between releases and spliced older-basis values are marked estimate.
Co-movement links are 13-week correlations of weekly returns — they show moving together, not cause.

pools.label: Deposits (banks & non-banks)
pools.src: BoK flow of funds 281Y002: deposit-taking corporations (S122), cash & deposits, liabilities (quarterly)
pools.note: weekly values interpolated between quarters; before 2008 Q4: older 2002~2013 basis scaled to match

pools.label: Dollar (USD/KRW)
pools.note: price: won per dollar (up = weaker won)

pools.label: Korean bonds (all issuers)
pools.src: BoK flow of funds 281Y002: domestic sectors (S1), bonds, liabilities (quarterly)
pools.note: government, BoK (MSB), bank, corporate and asset-backed bonds; weekly values interpolated; before 2008 Q4: older 2002~2013 basis scaled to match

pools.label: Housing (all Korea)
pools.src: BoK national balance sheet 291Y524: market value of all dwellings (year-end)
pools.note: annual figure; weeks in between are interpolated, and the last year-end is held

pools.label: Listed stocks (KOSPI + KOSDAQ)
pools.note: between month-ends: scaled by the KOSPI index and corrected to hit each official month-end
